root.name: Bogo-Indian Defense: Nimzowitsch Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. Nf3 Bb4+ 4. Bd2 Qe7

overview: Black develops 4...Qe7 against Bd2 and plays ...O-O, ...d6 and ...Nc6 or ...b6. White usually fianchettoes with 5.g3 or develops with Nc3 to keep the bishop pair. The play is a slow manoeuvring game with few forcing lines.

white_ideas.idea: Fianchetto with g3 and Bg2 and keep the bishop pair
Play Nc3 and e4 for a centre

black_ideas.idea: Trade the dark bishop or keep it, and aim for ...d6 and ...e5
Develop with ...Nc6 and ...O-O and use the queen on e7

typical_structures.structure: Queen's Gambit-style pawn centre with flexible tension

character.notes: Safe Black set-up with few early weaknesses.

structure.notes: Flexible: pawns on c4 and d4 against e6 and d6 with tension.

plans.reason: White fianchettoes and keeps the bishops.
